svg.title: Issued realization is not post-invoice recoverability
svg.desc: Standard time less negotiation gap, time-entry reductions, and proforma write-downs yields issued net time fees. Invoice write-offs reduce recoverability, not issued realization. Cash reduces receivables. Every adjustment is attributed once to the same issued-month cohort and currency through Invoice, Matter, and PracticeGroup.
